data.name: Kameelah
data.gender_notes: Kameelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The most perfect, beautiful one. The name Kameelah carries the meaning “Perfect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kameelah usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will embody the highest spiritual ideals and bring beauty and perfection into the world.
data.etymology: Kameelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kameelah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_english.name: Kameelah
in_english.long_meaning: Kameelah is derived from Arabic roots, signifying perfection, completeness, and beauty. The name reflects a sense of divine completion and aesthetic appeal, resonating deeply within Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Kameelah, with its elegant and sublime meaning, adds a unique charm and exquisiteness to those who bear it. In Islamic culture, the essence of perfection and beauty is found in Allah (God) alone. Thus, the name Kameelah is reserved for those who strive to emulate the divine qualities of mercy, compassion, and the highest moral standards. It signifies a heightened sense of kindred spirit with the Almighty in upholding the noblest virtues.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Kameelah signifies being the epitome of God's creation- being the Best in all aspects, both in the physical and spiritual world. It calls for continuous efforts to fine-tune one's character and refine one's actions, as striven for in a deep and genuine religious commitment. The name Kameelah inspires to become the preferred choice for Allah in the hereafter- to strive for a life of steady spiritual growth and the constant pursuit of wisdom and knowledge for the sake of Allah. embodying compassion, beauty and above all, the fear and love of Allah, inspiring others to aspire for the same ideals.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Perfect" symbolizes The most perfect, beautiful one. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kameelah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of perfect.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Kameelah bint Abd al-Malik (d. 731) was a prominent Umayyad princess and the wife of Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kameelah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Kameelah in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Kameelah, which means "Perfect". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
